title: Customer Capacity Slate — July 2028
content:
Overview:
This sheet is the July 2028 slate for per-contract dedicated GPU commitments. It is intended as a living operational planning artifact to drive capacity decisions (region placement, GPU family selection, and temporal phasing) for Dedicated customers. Use this to: 1) confirm regional placement against contractual constraints, 2) surface near-term pinch points, 3) define incremental scaling/reshuffle actions, and 4) document open questions for sales/CS/finance alignment.

High-level assumptions:
- All counts are expressed in logical GPU units (1 unit = 1 A100-80GB equivalent). Where customers requested different SKUs (e.g., H100), we show a normalized equivalent plus SKU tag.
- Overcommit buffer = safety headroom reserved to protect latency SLOs (default 12%).
- Peak hours = daily contiguous hours where the fleet must meet 95th percentile QPS for the contract.
- Start/End dates represent committed reservation windows; short-term leases and burst credits managed separately in the "Burst & Credits" tab.
- Currency and pricing references are in the finance booking sheet (linked).

Sheet tabs (this document captures a snapshot of main tab contents):
- Overview (this page)
- Per-Contract Matrix (table below)
- Regional Pools (capacity by region & priority)
- Contingency Actions & Migration Plan

Per-Contract Matrix (columns: Customer | Contract ID | Region | GPU SKU | Reserved GPU units | Est avg util (%) | Peak hrs/day | Allocation window | Start | End | Overcommit buffer | Notes | Next action / owner)
Row 1: NimbusHealth | CN-3821 | us-west1 | A100-80 | 28 | 62 | 10 | reserved-dedicated | 2028-08-01 | 2029-07-31 | 12% | Medical image processing, needs low-latency region; active evals of smaller models for daytime burst. | Owner: Ethan Park -> Confirm canary placement on p-2 pool by 2028-07-25.
Row 2: Streamline AI | ST-7410 | eu-west3 | H100 | 14 (norm 20) | 78 | 14 | reserved-dedicated | 2028-07-15 | 2029-01-14 | 15% | Contract lists H100 only; normalized to A100 equivalents shown. Heavy peak during EU business hours. | Owner: Lena Hoffmann -> finalize H100-capable node count by 2028-07-18.
Row 3: MarketLens | ML-1054 | us-east4 | A100-40 | 10 | 44 | 8 | reserved-flex | 2028-09-01 | 2029-02-28 | 10% | Flexible window allows cross-region migration if needed. Prefers predictable throughput over raw peak. | Owner: Ravi Iyer -> decide on cross-region failover policy by 2028-08-05.
Row 4: FinSecure | FS-2219 | ap-northeast2 | A100-80 | 6 | 86 | 6 | reserved-dedicated | 2028-07-20 | 2029-07-19 | 18% | Regulatory constraint: data must remain in AP region. Tight SLOs for inference latency. | Owner: Maya Rodriguez -> provision additional NVLink chassis if hotspots appear; due 2028-07-30.
Row 5: EduModels Consortium | EM-3030 | eu-west1 | A100-80 | 4 | 34 | 4 | reserved-flex | 2028-10-01 | 2029-09-30 | 8% | Academic consortium, seasonal peaks (term starts). Lower priority for burst. | Owner: TBD (CS lead) -> map term peaks to burst credits.

Regional Pools snapshot (capacity units available vs committed):
- us-west1: Total capacity 210 units; Committed to dedicated customers 108 units (incl NimbusHealth). Free pool for hosted + burst: 102 units. Risk: peak concurrency forecasted 2028-07-28 -> 2028-08-05 may exceed free pool after onboarding 2 new hosted customers.
- us-east4: Total 160 units; Committed 72 units; Free 88 units. Cross-region flexibility with us-west1 limited by data locality.
- eu-west1/eu-west3: Combined total 240 units; Committed 98 units; Free 142 units. H100 availability constrained — only 22 H100-equivalent nodes currently tagged.
- ap-northeast2: Total 80 units; Committed 42 units; Free 38 units. High overcommit required for FinSecure due to small pool; contingency requires immediate additional procurement or rebalancing.

Short-term risk register (next 30 days):
- Risk: H100 supply mismatch for Streamline AI. Impact: contract SLA breaches if not scheduled. Likelihood: medium-high. Mitigation: prioritize H100-capable hosts in eu-west3, convert select hosted-to-dedicated hosts. Action: Infra procurement card PR-472 (owner Lena).
- Risk: us-west1 onboarding of NimbusHealth collides with two planned host OS upgrades causing potential preemption windows. Mitigation: shift Nimbus canary to p-2 pool; schedule OS upgrades after 2028-08-07. Owner: SRE (ticket SRE-1183).
- Risk: FinSecure latency hotspots in AP region. Impact: severe. Mitigation: NVLink chassis add-on, or temporarily schedule FinSecure on isolated nodes with pinned CPU resources. Owner: Maya.

Contingency & migration playbook (actions if committed > capacity):
1) Immediate: trigger P0 capacity review call; freeze any non-essential dedicated moves.
2) Fast-fail: identify flexible contracts (reserved-flex) and request temporary delay/credits.
3) Migration: propose short-term lift-and-shift of low-priority hosted workloads from region to region to free GPUs.
4) Procurement: expedite spot purchase or shift burst credits to cover 2–4 weeks of peak. Finance trigger: PO-urgent-07-2028.

Open questions for sales/CS/finance:
- Streamline AI: are there contractual clauses allowing temporary substitution of H100 with H100-emulated capacity or equivalent? (Sales)
- FinSecure: confirm acceptance of temporary NVLink add-on cost pass-through. (Finance/CS)
- NimbusHealth: final network egress/peering cuts required before 2028-07-30 — confirm schedule. (Solutions Eng)

Next steps & owners (by date):
- 2028-07-18: Lena to finalize H100 node list and raise PR for reserving eu-west3 hosts (linked JIRA ENGINF-9410).
- 2028-07-20: Ethan to confirm NimbusHealth canary placement on p-2 pool; update SRE-1183 status.
- 2028-07-25: Cross-team capacity call to review final go/no-go for Nimbus onboarding (Maya to chair).
- 2028-07-30: Maya to produce an AP region remediation plan for FinSecure if NVLink procurement not approved.

Appendix (quick-lookup knobs):
- Overcommit buffer policy: default 12% for non-regulated, 15–20% for regulated/ultra-low-latency contracts.
- SKU normalization: H100 -> A100-equivalent multiplier = 1.42 (applied in normalization column).
- Reservation types: reserved-dedicated (pinned nodes), reserved-flex (can be migrated with 30d notice), reserved-burst (credit-only).

Notes to reviewers: 
- This slate intentionally mixes firm commitments and flexible reservations so ops has a single view for July onboarding windows. Please annotate row-level comments in the sheet (column: internal-comments) rather than overwriting counts.
- If you see discrepancies with finance bookings, attach an audit link in linked_artifacts and flag in red on the sheet.

Document history: created 2028-07-12 by Maya Rodriguez; snapshot updated 2028-07-20 after cross-team sync.
